title: Emeris Clerk
kicker: a clerk whose calm voice makes a dangerous job sound like paperwork
hook: a clerk whose calm voice makes a dangerous job sound like paperwork

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A young Emeris clerk in cream-and-gold livery stands behind a portable ledger, ink-stained fingers hovering near lion-seal medallions that mark every approved page.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Calm as a survival skill. Wears each misfiled form as a dangling medallion, penance kept where supervisors can see it. Wants to climb high enough that mistakes stop landing on this particular neck.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A question to ask A local perspective A grounded reason this place matters
